page.overview:
Who is Odovacar Bolger?

Odovacar Bolger was a Hobbit of the Shire.

Odovacar was the son of Herugar Bolger and Jessamine Boffin. After his father's death, he became the head of the Bolger family. He was the husband of Rosamunda Took and father of Fredegar Bolger and Estella. He died at the age of 106.

In , Odovacar Bolger is a pig farmer living in Budgeford. He asks the player to investigate the rumour of a Black Rider seen at his farm at night, but it turns out to be simply another hobbit playing panks.
